title: The bridegroom
gist: The prophets picture God as husband of his people (Hosea, Isaiah, Ezekiel), and the Song of Songs was read in that light. Jesus calls himself the bridegroom when he is asked why his disciples do not fast, and tells parables of the wedding feast. Revelation ends with the marriage of the Lamb.

passages.note: 'As the bridegroom rejoiceth over the bride, so shall thy God rejoice over thee.'
'Can the children of the bridegroom mourn?'
'He that hath the bride is the bridegroom.'
